correctness.rationale: A proposed Minkowski center satisfies reflected upper-set vertex inequalities exactly iff all coordinates lie between 1 and the factor and every cover raises the rescaled coordinate by at least one. A longest chain forces factor at least h and the longest-ending-chain labeling attains it. The center region at scale h+1 equals the convex hull of integral strict labelings by directed-incidence total unimodularity. Equality on longest bottom–top paths pins precisely critical coordinates, and weighted longest paths, with every nonmaximal edge perturbed separately and averaged, supply strict slack and full freedom on every other coordinate. The accompanying standard-library program verifies exact rational affine ranks and reflected vertex inequalities on 1,219 bounded poset presentations, independent of the all-poset proof.

value.rationale: An exact natural all-poset geometric optimization theorem: specifies the asymmetry, the full feasible optimizer polytope, its canonical lattice interior-hull realization and a longest-chain support criterion for affine dimension and uniqueness. A nonpure poset can nevertheless have unique Minkowski center; disjoint chains with side cover exhibit the meaningful distinction from purity. The exact classification is structurally motivated by affine convex geometry and strict order-preserving combinatorics, not an arbitrary finite table or routine incremental constant. No downstream theorem or external validation is asserted.
